description.value: Mango Yummy is a family-owned dessert cafe in Richmond specializing in mango-inspired sweets and drinks, with roots at the Richmond Night Market. The brick-and-mortar location offers a broader selection of desserts than their market stall, including custom cakes and seasonal specials like mooncakes. A sweet stop for cyclists with a taste for fruit-forward Asian-style desserts.
